parsed.explanation: No trans-specific criminalisation, facility ban, border-document regime or organised police targeting is documented, and courts repeatedly remedy discrimination and medication denial, including ECtHR damages and annulment of LGBT-free resolutions. Against this, the worst documented traveler-facing exposure is detention: a trans foreign national was placed in a male guarded centre with 3-month HRT interruption, and a 2024 prison finding for HRT denial, showing birth-sex custody and care risk if detained. Hate-crime/hate-speech law does not cover gender identity after veto/unconstitutional ruling, leaving bias recourse thin. Documented political/religious hostility, residual local charters and dated 2019 march violence indicate societal hostility beyond friction, but 2019 survey is not current prevalence and no universal-exposure measure is shown. This is elevated-to-reduced risk: protections operate, but custody/medication and bias-recourse gaps remain.
